preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 20,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 100000 and isinstance(S, int) and 1 <= S <= 10**16 for n, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 2 and 100,000, and S is between 1 and 10^16.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and 1 <= w <= 10**6 and c in (1, 2) for v, u, w, c in all_edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects valid vertices, has weight between 1 and 10^6, and cost is either 1 or 2.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 and is_tree(n, edges) for n, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case describes a valid tree with n vertices and n-1 edges.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and int(line) >= 0 for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.

postconditions.expression: all(min_cost_for_case(case, S) == int(stdout_lines[i]) for i, case in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output equals the minimum total cost to reduce the sum of root-to-leaf path weights to at most S, where min_cost_for_case computes the optimal cost by selecting edge reductions (w := floor(w/2)) with associated costs c_i.
